create.name: Yogi Bryan
create.bio:
Yogi Bryan is an American meditation and yoga nidra guide known for bringing humour and plain, often salty language to relaxation practice. He began with an Instagram account poking fun at how seriously people take yoga, then committed to meditating every day for ninety days and never stopped; listening to hypnotic recordings as he slept led him to study the subconscious mind. He is a registered yoga teacher at the 200-hour level, and he trained in hypnotherapy with David Snyder and in neuro-linguistic programming with Richard Bandler.

His guided practices aim to help restless minds settle, rest deeply and fall asleep, combining yoga nidra, guided meditation and sleep hypnosis, sometimes set to binaural tones. His meditation podcast and YouTube channel carry long-form sessions for sleep, calm, self-worth and couples, and his book It's Just F*cking Meditation is a light-hearted introduction to sitting practice. He runs the Chill Pill app, whose programmes include a forty-night series of sleep sessions, and he also leads talks and sessions at festivals and events.
